text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/submission/solution.in
+# Nb [001] flyer impact using the Fellinger-Park-Wilkins EAM potential.
+# metal units: length Angstrom, time ps, velocity Angstrom/ps.
+units metal
+dimension 3
+atom_style atomic
+boundary p p f
+
+# Static geometry. The supplied potential specifies a = 3.3079 Angstrom.
+variable a equal 3.3079
+variable lx equal 20.0*v_a
+variable ly equal 20.0*v_a
+variable projectile_lo equal -0.25*v_a
+variable interface_cut equal 19.75*v_a
+variable target_hi equal 59.75*v_a
+variable gap equal 15.0
+variable target_shift equal v_gap-0.5*v_a
+
+lattice bcc ${a} orient x 1 0 0 orient y 0 1 0 orient z 0 0 1
+region simulation block 0.0 ${lx} 0.0 ${ly} -2000.0 4000.0 units box
+create_box 1 simulation
+
+# Cuts between (001) planes avoid extra surface layers at free boundaries.
+# Projectile: 20 x 20 x 20 conventional BCC cells, 16000 atoms.
+region projectile_region block 0.0 ${lx} 0.0 ${ly} ${projectile_lo} ${interface_cut} units box
+create_atoms 1 region projectile_region
+group projectile region projectile_region
+
+# Target: 20 x 20 x 40 conventional BCC cells, 32000 atoms.
+region target_region block 0.0 ${lx} 0.0 ${ly} ${interface_cut} ${target_hi} units box
+create_atoms 1 region target_region
+group target region target_region
+
+# Before this shift, the facing planes are separated by a/2.
+# Afterwards the outermost projectile and target planes are 15 Angstrom apart.
+displace_atoms target move 0.0 0.0 ${target_shift} units box
+
+mass 1 92.90638
+pair_style eam/alloy
+pair_coeff * * /app/inputs/prompt3.potential Nb
+neighbor 2.0 bin
+neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes
+
+# Initialize each body's thermal velocities with zero center-of-mass velocity.
+velocity projectile create 300.0 4928459 mom yes rot no dist gaussian
+velocity target create 300.0 8372911 mom yes rot no dist gaussian
+timestep 0.001
+thermo 1000
+thermo_style custom step time atoms temp pe ke etotal press
+
+# Isochoric equilibration at 300 K for 100 ps (100000 steps at 1 fs).
+fix equil_projectile projectile nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
+fix equil_target target nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
+run 100000
+unfix equil_projectile
+unfix equil_target
+
+# Add +2 km/s along [001] to all projectile atoms, retaining thermal motion.
+# 2 km/s = 20 Angstrom/ps; the target is initially stationary on average.
+velocity projectile set 0.0 0.0 20.0 sum yes units box
+
+# Adiabatic impact and subsequent expansion for 50 ps, with no thermostat.
+fix impact all nve
+run 50000
*** End Patch"));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"mkdir -p /app/smoke
cat > /app/smoke/check.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/lammps/python')
from lammps import lammps

source = Path('/app/submission/solution.in').read_text()
setup, dynamics = source.split('# Initialize each body', 1)
engine = lammps(cmdargs=['-log', '/app/smoke/lammps.log', '-screen', 'none'])
engine.commands_string(setup)
natoms = int(engine.get_natoms())
positions = engine.gather_atoms('x', 1, 3)
masks = engine.gather_atoms('mask', 0, 1)
projectile = [i for i in range(natoms) if masks[i] & 2]
target = [i for i in range(natoms) if masks[i] & 4]
assert natoms == 48000, natoms
assert len(projectile) == 16000, len(projectile)
assert len(target) == 32000, len(target)
projectile_planes = {round(positions[3*i+2], 8) for i in projectile}
target_planes = {round(positions[3*i+2], 8) for i in target}
assert len(projectile_planes) == 40, len(projectile_planes)
assert len(target_planes) == 80, len(target_planes)
gap = min(target_planes) - max(projectile_planes)
assert abs(gap - 15.0) < 1e-8, gap
print(f'Geometry: {len(projectile)} projectile atoms in {len(projectile_planes)} planes; {len(target)} target atoms in {len(target_planes)} planes; gap = {gap:.8f} Angstrom', flush=True)

# Execute the same initialization, thermostat removal, and velocity addition,
# shortening only the run lengths and thermo reporting interval.
smoke = '# Initialize each body' + dynamics
smoke = smoke.replace('run 100000', 'run 20').replace('run 50000', 'run 1000').replace('thermo 1000', 'thermo 100')
before_nve, nve_run = smoke.rsplit('run 1000', 1)
engine.commands_string(before_nve)
velocities = engine.gather_atoms('v', 1, 3)
projectile_vz = sum(velocities[3*i+2] for i in projectile) / len(projectile)
target_vz = sum(velocities[3*i+2] for i in target) / len(target)
assert abs((projectile_vz - target_vz) - 20.0) < 1e-10, (projectile_vz, target_vz)
print(f'Post-boost relative velocity: {projectile_vz-target_vz:.12f} Angstrom/ps = 2 km/s', flush=True)
start = time.monotonic()
